text:
Maia: CI smoke red on canary cluster — job 5821 failed on h100 nodes. test: tests/inference/test_warmup.py::test_parallel_warmup. Logs show repeated 'invalid device function' + Xid 79 kernel timeouts. can someone triage? @Ryan @Asha :eyes:
ci-bot: Job 5821 failed on pool=canary-h100. Rerun: https://ci.redwood/5821 
Ryan: on it. grabbing logs now. can you paste the kernel error excerpt?
Maia: sure, excerpt below:
```
I0321 14:02:13.124 kernel: h100_0: GPU hung, recovery required (Xid 79)
cuda: cuLaunchKernel returned 700 (cudaErrorLaunchTimeout)
runtime: cudaErrorInvalidDeviceFunction at inference/kernels/quantize.cu:211
stack: backtrace ... cuModuleGetFunction -> cuLaunchKernel
```
Asha: hmm looks like a CUDA toolkit vs driver mismatch or a PTX JIT failure. what image/tag does the CI job use?
Maia: image: redwood/inference:ci-horizon-cuda12.2-2026-03-15
Kevin: host driver on canary h100 pool is 535.86 currently. CUDA 12.2 should be compatible but weird if PTX JIT triggers invalid device function. could be mismatched libcuda on host vs container runtime.
Sophia: we've seen similar when the node had an older kernel module after a partial driver roll. quick check: can ops confirm nvidia-smi + modinfo?
ops-bot: Requested node diagnostics for job 5821 -> node=canary-h100-07. nvidia-smi: Driver Version: 535.86, CUDA Version (from nvidia-smi): 12.2. Kernel module build id: 0x7f9a.
Ryan: ops-bot output looks nominal. two options: 1) requeue job on a node with an alternate driver build (some nodes still on 535.84) or 2) rerun with environment forcing precompiled kernels (set ENV NO_PTX_JIT=1) to avoid JIT.
Maia: can we requeue onto a compat pool? I can also try NO_PTX_JIT and rerun locally.
ops-bot: Requeued job 5821 -> pool=gpu-compat-535 (node canary-h100-14). Rerun link: https://ci.redwood/5821?attempt=retry-1
ci-bot: Rerun started: 5821-retry-1.
Ryan: thanks — watching. if the retry still fails we'll request a bisect and tag eng-ml-oncall. please add any logs to the rerun build.
Maia: will do. thx everyone :thumbsup:
